beam_transition: elitist pool of parents plus valid children; deduplicate finite semantic cells and retain the best-loss anchor plus the public-evidence constraint frontier
claim: heuristic search benchmark, not importance sampling or posterior inference

component_signature.interpretation: finite observational equivalence, not global equivalence

exact_stop: finish all scheduled expansions in the active round, then stop before the next round
expansion_schedule: one expansion in round 1 and exactly beam_width expansions in each later round; cycle retained states if the semantic beam is underfull
hole_policy: violated sound singleton predicate constraints first; then violated singleton mapper constraints; then predicate-toggle support; then conditional mapper constraints; otherwise follow the configured stall policy
invalid_or_duplicate_shortlist_policy: a semantic invalid, duplicate, or no-op response consumes all K proposal slots; it produces no children and receives no within-call retry or backfill. Infrastructure failure aborts and seals the trial
large_space_note: The LLM request generates only K repairs and receives neither component-catalog cardinalities nor a complete-program list. The finite grammar can still make its size inferable; the claim is that generation does not require enumeration.
output_encoding: typed grammar objects constrained by operators and constants
provider_candidate_order_contract: most to least promising; retained as ordinal rank
ranking: finite semantic cells; best complete-program loss anchor plus a public singleton constraint frontier ranked by predicate violations, mapper violations, loss, proposal rank, parent rank, and SHA256 tie break
